adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a substantial rewrite of `loadUsers` in `handleNewBooking.ts` that goes beyond the destinationCalendar refactor: it adds new validation/throw paths (`dynamicUserList` must be a non-empty array; `hosts` must be an array) and wraps the whole function in a try/catch that can convert unexpected errors into a generic 500 (`Unable to load users`). It also removes `organization: { select: { slug: true } }` from the `prisma.user.findMany` select (previously present), which is a concrete, behavior-changing data shape change. Whether any downstream consumer actually requires `user.organization.slug` isn’t verifiable from this diff alone, but the scope creep + silent removal of selected data is a specific, diff-grounded review concern.
